row.evidence: AppFolio's pricing page lists no SSO or SCIM feature on Core, Plus or Max, and its help centre (help.appfolio.com) redirects to the AppFolio sign-in page, so provisioning support is not publicly documented.
row.notes: Status unchanged (unknown). Price changed since June: the pricing page's structured data now gives Residential Core at $1.49 per unit/month with a 50-unit minimum (June: $1.40/unit/mo, 200-unit minimum), Plus $3.20 and Max $5.00 per unit/month; the visible cards say Get a Quote with minimum spend. Pricing is per unit, not per user, so per-user fields stay null. The AppFolio Stack API includes a read-only Users resource (list users with email, name and role); the plan card lists AppFolio API (read only) on Plus and read/write on Max, so API access sits above the Core plan. No SSO or SCIM page was found on appfolio.com, and okta.com/integrations/appfolio/ returned 404.

user_api.notes: AppFolio Stack API overview lists a Users resource; method and path are not shown on the public page.

limitations.text: The Users resource is read-only (get users matching filters, incremental by LastUpdatedAtFrom) and returns Id, Email, FirstName, LastName and UserRole; no create or deactivate is listed.
Plus gets read-only API access; read/write needs Max.

fallbacks.notes: docs_public left null: help.appfolio.com redirects to the AppFolio account sign-in page (no quotable page), while the Stack API overview is public.
